modules.title: Introduction to Aiki (Verbs)
modules.html:
Hausa verb forms, tenses and aspects. This section covers introduction to aiki (verbs).

Key points

  • Karin magana: 'Aiki da cikawa...' — Shi ne nagari.
  • Cika: 'Ladan aiki ...' — ...shine samu..
  • Menene ma'anar 'Sannu da aiki' — Well done.

A: ...shine samu. — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: ...shine samu..

  • Menene ma'anar 'Sannu da aiki' — Well done.

quiz.q: Karin magana: 'Aiki da cikawa...'
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Shi ne nagari.

quiz.q: Cika: 'Ladan aiki ...'
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: ...shine samu..

quiz.q: Menene ma'anar 'Sannu da aiki'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Well done.

quiz.q: Mene ne kalmar nan 'Guda' take nufi a cikin jimlar 'Na ga guda uku'?
quiz.solution: 'Guda' acts as a counter or unit, referring to the quantity of items.

quiz.q: Wacce dabba ce ake kira 'Sarkin dawa'?
quiz.solution: 'Sarkin dawa' means 'King of the forest/bush', which refers to the Lion (Zaki).

quiz.q: Wanne bakari (consonant) ne ake kiran sa 'K' dake tare da 'y'?
quiz.solution: 'Ky' is a labialized/palatalized consonant in Hausa phonology.

quiz.q: Menene ma'anar 'Dan-koli'?
quiz.solution: A 'Dan-koli' is a traditional petty trader who travels to sell small household wares.

quiz.q: A ina ake yin sana'ar 'Fatuwa'?
quiz.solution: 'Fatuwa' is the traditional long-distance trading system.

quiz.q: Menene 'Amshi' a cikin waka?
quiz.solution: Amshi refers to the refrain or the response provided by the backup singers.

quiz.q: Wanene ya kera wannan: 'Ina son riga _____.' (White)?
quiz.solution: 'Fara' is the feminine adjective for white, agreeing with the feminine noun 'riga'.

quiz.q: Wanene yake jan ragamar fada (King's palace)?
quiz.solution: The 'Sarkin Pada' is the head of the palace administration.

quiz.q: Mene ne ma'anar 'Halin kwarai'?
quiz.solution: 'Halin kwarai' refers to having good, upright character.

quiz.q: Menene 'Pronoun'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Wakilin Suna.

quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Fartanya.

quiz.q: Wanne ne kalmar 'Namiji'?

quiz.q: Menene 'Littafi'?

quiz.q: Kishiyar kalmar 'Fari' ita ce...
